Title: Demand Planning Manager
Description: Meet the Team Join the Global Planning organization within Cisco’s Supply Chain. We are a collaborative, strategic, and highly analytical team dedicated to accurately establishing demand plans that satisfy customer needs and support Cisco’s overall Operating Plan. We are currently investing in next-generation planning technologies and approaches to set the operational and financial guardrails for our Corporate Operating Plan. As a member of the Compute (CSPBU) planning team, you will work with a global group of innovators who value technical excellence, cross-functional partnership, and data-driven decision-making. Your Impact As a Demand Planning Manager, you will drive the demand signal that powers our entire supply chain fulfillment engine. By employing sophisticated analytics and cross-functional intelligence, you will ensure our product plans are aligned with business objectives, revenue targets, and margin goals. Your work will directly influence how we handle inventory, respond to market changes, and provide elite service to our customers. You will act as a key advisor to partners, turning complex data into actionable insights that optimize our supply chain performance. Drive an outstanding Demand Plan by collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, BU Marketing, Regional Sales & Operations, and Distribution Planning teams. Analyze and plan based on portfolio strategies, corporate plans, competition, price sensitivities, geo-political changes, and regulatory compliance. Evaluate product margins and portfolio forecasts to influence product mix and drive strategies that optimize overall profitability. Develop demand signals and buffers using advanced analytics and predictive modeling (e.g., time series, causal, and judgmental methods). Align with the Central Material & Fulfillment team on demand handoffs, guardrails, and supply buffers. Engage with BU Marketing and Regional Planning to improve pipeline visibility and tracking of key customer demand. Drive predictive revenue and margin planning in partnership with Finance and Central Revenue Planning. Build toward standardization, automation, and scalability across processes, data, and analytics to ensure continuous improvement. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field (or 8+ years of equivalent professional experience). 5+ years of professional experience in Supply Chain, specifically within Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), or Demand Planning. Proven experience in building predictive models using time series, causal, or judgmental forecasting methods. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data sets and translate them into actionable demand signals. Experience collaborating with cross-functional partners such as Sales, Finance, or Marketing to line up with on business plans. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration (MBA) or a related quantitative field. Deep understanding of end-to-end planning processes, including inventory management, product life-cycle management, and supply chain financials. Experience with supply chain modeling and the implementation of automation in planning workflows. Strong strategic mentality with the ability to influence and collaborate with partners at various levels of the organization. Proven track record to quickly learn complex domains and chip in to business outcomes with minimal direction. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

We demonstrate every day that talent, creativity, and technical excellence have no borders by delivering world-class solutions that inspire people to dream big and move faster. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.

Description: Responsabilidades Aplicar y mantener la Arquitectura de Datos que fue definida por el Ingeniero de Datos Sr, para que el flujo de información cuente con el performance requerido. Diseñar e implementar una arquitectura de datos robusta y escalable que integre sistemas internos (ERP, PIM, OMS) y externos (marketplaces, herramientas de análisis) en tiempo real, asegurando rendimiento y resiliencia. Colocar los datos al alcance de los usuarios que los necesitan, para habilitar la toma de decisiones basada en Datos y puedan explotarlos para dar inicio a solicitudes tecnológicas, nuevas funcionalidades, nuevas plataformas, etc. Garantizar que los datos del ecommerce (transacciones, inventarios, comportamiento de usuarios) estén disponibles en plataformas de análisis para apoyar decisiones estratégicas de negocio. Optimizar los flujos de datos para experiencias Omnicanal mediante desarrollos de integración de datos con tecnologías en la nube con soluciones modernas y complejas que se comporten de forma correcta y sin errores. Crear pipelines que permitan sincronizar precios, inventarios, y promociones entre tiendas físicas, ecommerce y marketplaces, asegurando coherencia en tiempo real. Garantizar la calidad e integridad de los datos para que los datos sean precisos, consistentes y homologados a los términos del negocio y estén listos para su uso. Desarrollar e implementar con escalabilidad y resiliencia de los Sistemas de Datos para que no afecte el incremento en volumen o el uso de los datos, sino que pueda seguir funcionando de una manera óptima y eficiente en todo momento, con la guía del Ingeniero de Datos Sr. Implementar soluciones que soporten grandes volúmenes de datos provenientes de millones de usuarios y productos, manejando picos de demanda y escenarios de alta carga. Seguir los lineamientos para el manejo de información sensible y asegurar la conformidad con las Normativas de Privacidad ya que son los principales actores en la manipulación, uso y exposición de datos para las necesidades del negocio. Trabajar estrechamente con equipos de desarrollo, arquitectura, negocio y marketing para alinear la estrategia de datos con los objetivos de crecimiento y optimización del ecommerce. Garantizar la disponibilidad de los datos en los sistemas y ap Perfil Deseado 2 años de experiencia en ingeniería de datos o desarrollo backend con manejo de datos. Conocimiento de plataformas de integración como MuleSoft o Apigee (API Gateway, políticas de seguridad, manejo de errores). Conocimientos de Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especialmente BigQuery y Cloud Storage . Python y SQL intermedio (transformaciones, limpieza de datos, ETL). Experiencia básica en control de versiones con Git/GitHub. Mentalidad analítica y orientación a la solución de problemas. Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y aprender de ingenieros senior.
